items.title: Dimanche matin : erreurs d'hier + voix passive

questions.prompt: Each of the hotel rooms ------- a view of the sea.
questions.explanation: Each of + pluriel → singulier : has.

questions.prompt: Neither the brochures nor the poster ------- ready yet.
questions.explanation: Neither… nor : accord avec le plus proche (the poster, singulier) → is.

questions.prompt: The information in these files ------- confidential.
questions.explanation: Information = indénombrable → singulier : is.

questions.prompt: Ms. Rossi prepared the presentation by -------.
questions.explanation: PRONOMS : by + pronom RÉFLÉCHI = tout(e) seul(e) → by herself.

questions.prompt: The new manager introduced ------- to the team on Monday.
questions.explanation: Réfléchi quand le sujet et l'objet sont la même personne : introduced himself.

questions.prompt: If you have any questions, please contact Mr. Lee or -------.
questions.explanation: Après un verbe / une préposition → pronom COMPLÉMENT : me.

questions.prompt: The decision was ours, not -------.
questions.explanation: Pronom POSSESSIF seul (sans nom après) : theirs (= leur décision).

items.title: Mercredi après-midi : priorités, Partie 6 et pronoms

questions.prompt: The board admired the CEO's ------- during the crisis.
questions.explanation: Possessif + NOM : decisiveness (-ness). Famille : decide → decisive (adj.) → decisiveness (nom).

questions.prompt: The supervisor suggested ------- the meeting until next week.
questions.explanation: SUGGEST + -ING : suggested postponing.

questions.prompt: Our cleaners ------- the offices every evening.
questions.explanation: Habitude (every evening) + sujet PLURIEL (cleaners) → clean, sans -s.

questions.prompt: Ms. Nakamura completed the report -------, without any help.
questions.explanation: RÉFLÉCHI : herself (elle-même, toute seule).

questions.prompt: The laptop on the desk is -------; I left mine at home.
questions.explanation: Pronom POSSESSIF seul : hers (= le sien).

questions.prompt: [Partie 6] « Attention all employees: Starting next Monday, the main parking lot will be (1) ___ for resurfacing. Staff may park in the lot behind Building C (2) ___ the work is completed. (3) ___ Shuttle buses will run every ten minutes between the lot and the main entrance. We thank you for (4) ___ cooperation. » — (1)
questions.explanation: PASSIF : will be closed (le parking est fermé).

questions.prompt: [Partie 6] « Attention all employees: Starting next Monday, the main parking lot will be (1) ___ for resurfacing. Staff may park in the lot behind Building C (2) ___ the work is completed. (3) ___ Shuttle buses will run every ten minutes between the lot and the main entrance. We thank you for (4) ___ cooperation. » — (2)
questions.explanation: UNTIL = jusqu'à ce que (durée : on se gare là-bas jusqu'à la fin des travaux).

questions.prompt: [Partie 6] « Attention all employees: Starting next Monday, the main parking lot will be (1) ___ for resurfacing. Staff may park in the lot behind Building C (2) ___ the work is completed. (3) ___ Shuttle buses will run every ten minutes between the lot and the main entrance. We thank you for (4) ___ cooperation. » — (3)
options: The lot behind Building C has 200 spaces.
The cafeteria menu will change in May.
Please submit your vacation requests early.
questions.explanation: Phrase à insérer : elle doit parler du parking de remplacement, entre l'annonce et les navettes. Seule (A) fait le lien.

questions.prompt: [Partie 6] « Attention all employees: Starting next Monday, the main parking lot will be (1) ___ for resurfacing. Staff may park in the lot behind Building C (2) ___ the work is completed. (3) ___ Shuttle buses will run every ten minutes between the lot and the main entrance. We thank you for (4) ___ cooperation. » — (4)
questions.explanation: Adjectif possessif + NOM : your cooperation.

questions.prompt: Mr. Diaz and ------- will attend the trade fair in Milan.
questions.explanation: Pronom SUJET (le sujet du verbe will attend) : Mr. Diaz and I.

questions.prompt: The manager gave Ana and ------- the new schedules.
questions.explanation: Pronom COMPLÉMENT (gave … to me) : Ana and me.

questions.prompt: The company prides ------- on its excellent customer service.
questions.explanation: Expression : pride oneself on = être fier de → prides itself on.

questions.prompt: Applicants should bring a copy of ------- résumé to the interview.
questions.explanation: Adjectif possessif + NOM : their résumé.

questions.prompt: ------- who wish to attend the seminar must register by Friday.
questions.explanation: Those who = ceux qui (structure figée).

questions.prompt: The two companies agreed to share resources with ------- .
questions.explanation: each other = l'un l'autre (réciproque entre deux sujets).

items.title: Jeudi matin : tes erreurs d'hier + les relatifs

questions.prompt: The research team will ------- a series of tests on the new material.
questions.explanation: conduct tests / a survey / a study = mener, réaliser.

questions.prompt: The new branch ------- by the mayor last Saturday.
questions.explanation: PASSIF prétérit : la succursale est inaugurée par le maire → was opened by.

questions.prompt: Most of the equipment ------- replaced last year.
questions.explanation: Most of + INDÉNOMBRABLE (equipment) → singulier : was.

questions.prompt: Both the manager and her assistant ------- on vacation next week.
questions.explanation: Both… and → PLURIEL : are.

questions.prompt: The two partners have known ------- for over twenty years.
questions.explanation: Réciproque : each other (l'un l'autre).

questions.prompt: The audience was ------- by the speaker's presentation.
questions.explanation: Les personnes ressentent → -ED : inspired. La présentation était inspiring.

questions.prompt: The intern suggested ------- a new filing system.
questions.explanation: RAPPEL (maîtrisée) : suggest + -ING.

questions.prompt: The client praised the firm's ------- in solving the problem.
questions.explanation: RAPPEL (maîtrisée) : possessif + NOM : creativity.

questions.prompt: The candidate ------- résumé impressed us most will be hired.
questions.explanation: RELATIFS : whose + NOM = dont le/la (le candidat DONT le CV…).

questions.prompt: The supplier ------- we contacted yesterday has not replied.
questions.explanation: whom = complément d'une PERSONNE (we contacted him → whom). « who » serait aussi toléré à l'oral, mais au TOEIC whom est la réponse attendue ici.

questions.prompt: The report, ------- was published on Monday, contains several errors.
questions.explanation: Après une VIRGULE, on n'utilise jamais « that » : which pour une chose.

questions.prompt: This is the office ------- the meeting will take place.
questions.explanation: Lieu + phrase complète → where (= in which).

questions.prompt: Employees ------- wish to attend the workshop must register online.
questions.explanation: Personne + sujet du verbe (they wish) → who.

questions.prompt: The conference room in ------- the interview was held is being renovated.
questions.explanation: Préposition + WHICH pour une chose (jamais « in that »).

questions.prompt: ------- you need is a valid passport and a confirmation number.
questions.explanation: WHAT = ce que / ce dont (sans antécédent) : What you need is…
